THE_ARCHITECT.talk.BLOODBINDER.0-0.char: I will repay my blood debt with your blood.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.BLOODBINDER.0-1.ancie: Strength bought with blood... you burned your own life into that blade.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.BLOODBINDER.1-0r.char: Every wound brings me one step closer to you.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.BLOODBINDER.1-1r.anci: Your blood will run dry sooner or later. What will be left of you then?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.BLOODBINDER.2-0r.char: Pain keeps me awake. It reminds me that I’m alive — and that you deserve to die.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.BLOODBINDER.2-1r.anci: Taking pain for strength... what a [b]pitiful[/b] creature.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.BLOODBINDER.3-0r.char: I have counted every drop. Now it’s your turn to repay.
DARV.talk.BLOODBINDER.0-0.ancient: Well well, someone wagering their own blood! That reek of blood on you is stronger than my whole collection!
DARV.talk.BLOODBINDER.0-1.char: My blood is precious. Do you have anything worth bleeding for?
DARV.talk.BLOODBINDER.1-0r.ancient: Still letting your own blood run, eh? Come, look through this pile — see anything you fancy!
DARV.talk.BLOODBINDER.1-1r.char: ...A few of them might barely be worthy.
DARV.talk.BLOODBINDER.2-0r.ancient: I just took in some bloodstained treasures — all saved for you!
NONUPEIPE.talk.BLOODBINDER.0-0.ancient: Oh? A visitor all in crimson. Your garments... are they dyed with your own blood?
NONUPEIPE.talk.BLOODBINDER.1-0r.ancient: We meet again, crimson child. Let me add a few matching ornaments for you.
NONUPEIPE.talk.BLOODBINDER.1-1r.char: As long as they’re sharp enough.
NONUPEIPE.talk.BLOODBINDER.2-0r.ancient: The crimson sits so beautifully on you. Come, accept my blessing.
NONUPEIPE.talk.BLOODBINDER.2-1r.char: I’ll make sure the Architect admires it too.
OROBAS.talk.BLOODBINDER.0-0.ancient: Red red red! Red everywhere!! You’re bleeding!? Does it hurt??
OROBAS.talk.BLOODBINDER.0-1.char: It hurts. But he’ll hurt far worse.
OROBAS.talk.BLOODBINDER.1-0r.ancient: Still bleeding!? No no no! Take this! Stop bleeding!!
OROBAS.talk.BLOODBINDER.1-1r.char: My blood won’t stop until he falls.
OROBAS.talk.BLOODBINDER.2-0r.ancient: Your blood will run out! Maybe the Architect can help? Want to talk?
OROBAS.talk.BLOODBINDER.2-1r.char: He’ll be the one to run dry first.
PAEL.talk.BLOODBINDER.0-0.ancient: [thinky_dots]You feed on your own blood. What a... painful path.[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.BLOODBINDER.1-1r.char: I won’t stop until the battle is over.
TANX.talk.BLOODBINDER.0-0.ancient: [b]Sharpening your blade on your own blood!? What a mad warrior![/b]
TANX.talk.BLOODBINDER.1-0r.ancient: [b]You’re still bleeding, warrior! Come choose a sharper weapon![/b]
TANX.talk.BLOODBINDER.2-1r.char: After the Architect falls in my blood.
TEZCATARA.talk.BLOODBINDER.0-0.ancient: Oh my, your [jitter][b]flame[/b][/jitter] is fueled by blood? How dangerous, dear.
TEZCATARA.talk.BLOODBINDER.0-1.char: What’s dangerous is whoever stands in my way.
TEZCATARA.talk.BLOODBINDER.1-0r.ancient: Come in, let me [jitter][b]burn[/b][/jitter] all the impurities from your wounds.
TEZCATARA.talk.BLOODBINDER.1-1r.char: Impurities? That’s the source of my power.
TEZCATARA.talk.BLOODBINDER.2-0r.ancient: Your blood is almost [jitter][b]boiled[/b][/jitter] dry, you know.
TEZCATARA.talk.BLOODBINDER.2-1r.char: Still enough to burn the Architect to ash.
VAKUU.talk.BLOODBINDER.0-0.ancient: A pact of blood? An amusing mortal. We could make a far better deal.
VAKUU.talk.BLOODBINDER.0-1.char: I’ve already signed a pact in blood.
VAKUU.talk.BLOODBINDER.1-0r.ancient: Your pain is [sine]delicious[/sine] — finer than any of my contracts.
VAKUU.talk.BLOODBINDER.2-0r.ancient: Bring me the Architect’s heart, and I’ll make sure your blood doesn’t spill in vain.
VAKUU.talk.BLOODBINDER.2-1r.char: His heart, I have other uses for.
